answer: For streaming glacier surveys to an island's ledge sensors, voting weight counts bytes delivered in fresh random transfer tests. Independent auditors measure delivery and sign receipts bound to an epoch and key. Validators check auditor signatures and reject invalid receipts or reused serials. Extra influence requires supplying more measured bandwidth; aliases add none. This trusts auditors to prevent overlapping tests from counting the same delivery twice; colluding auditors can fabricate receipts.
